name: Lo Lariv
overview: After seven days of grief, three estranged siblings- Penniless Yona, Talya, a teacher and single mother and Gur, known as the children's star "Traffic Light Gur", reunite to hear their father's will- only to discover their childhood apartment was left to a woman they've never heard of. Rage, fear, and curiosity send them on separate paths to find her. When they uncover that the mysterious lady is an escort, the siblings embark on a reckless and darkly comic journey of deception, crime, love, and betrayal; fighting each other every step of the way to reclaim the home they believe is rightfully theirs.
